name: Whisper Gate
mix: Two shields: Focus runs out, so win with Great Counters, not just Strikes. L11 swap: one Shield -> Brute.
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Layout copied from twin-shields. Theme and props from the hall-of-echoes draft room "whisper-gate". A tall arched gate with a stone ear on each side; soft sound-wave rings on the floor.
signs: Say something kind. Hear it come back.
